protocol: Every meaningful development candidate was opened across all 20 fixed images in four five-image comparison pages, followed by its automatically selected worst panel. DRUNet and CBM3D appear in every candidate page under the same noise draw.

preliminary_lambda_0p000.finding: Visibly noisy near-identity output with strong chroma speckle; ineligible because fitting sources overlapped development.

preliminary_normsure_v2_lambda_0p000.finding: Noise reduction accompanied by severe smoothing and mottled residuals; ineligible because three fitting sources overlapped development.

v3_lambda_0p0.finding: Visually indistinguishable from CBM3D, including the same fine-detail smoothing.

v3_lambda_0p01.finding: No visible MUSIQ artifact or texture recovery; effectively CBM3D.

v3_lambda_0p03.finding: No visible difference from CBM3D or lambda 0.01.

equal_fusion_v3.finding: Visible residual noise and mottling; uniform operator fusion is not viable.

dncnn.finding: Cleaner and often preserves fence, masonry, and fur detail better than the classical fusion; no obvious halo or color shift.

v4_lambda_0p0.finding: Near-CBM3D output with a slight NLM texture/noise blend in grass, water, and fur; no ringing or color shift.

v4_lambda_0p01.finding: Visually indistinguishable from CBM3D; no artifact and no visible texture recovery.

v4_lambda_0p03.finding: Again indistinguishable from CBM3D; DRUNet remains visibly crisper on eye, fence, and building detail.

selected_model.finding: All 20 plus worst were opened. Output is visually indistinguishable from CBM3D, with no added ringing or color shift and no perceptible recovery; DRUNet is generally cleaner on repeated facades and thin lines.

dncnn.finding: All 20 plus worst were opened. Blind DnCNN visibly softens or distorts repeated architectural patterns and fine lines on several crops, consistent with its weaker holdout metrics.

equal_fusion_v4.finding: All 20 plus worst were opened. Colored residual noise remains throughout, especially on flat and repeated regions.

architecture_gate_conclusion: The reference-only oracle headroom is too small and too sparse to justify spatial, multiscale, or sequential expansion. A2-A4 remain closed.
selection_conclusion: Among the required positive-lambda models, v4_lambda_0p01 has the highest fixed-development PSNR. On both development and sealed holdout, its tiny PSNR and DISTS gains over CBM3D accompany a statistically consistent SSIM regression. The full classical-improvement claim fails, and DRUNet remains decisively stronger.
